commands: python3 --version

/tmp/v/bin/pip install PyInquirer > /tmp/pip.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -15 /tmp/pip.log; echo "pip exit: $rc"; /tmp/v/bin/pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'pyinquirer|prompt|pygments'; test $rc -eq 0 && echo "VERDICT_LINE: PASS pip install PyInquirer exited 0 on $(python3 --version)" || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL pip install PyInquirer exited $rc"
python3 --version
/tmp/v/bin/python -c 'import prompt_toolkit; print("installed prompt_toolkit", prompt_toolkit.__version__)' || echo 'prompt_toolkit itself does not import'

/tmp/v/bin/python -c 'from PyInquirer import prompt, print_json; print("import ok:", prompt, print_json)' > /tmp/imp.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 /tmp/imp.log; echo "import exit: $rc"; test $rc -eq 0 && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS from PyInquirer import prompt, print_json succeeded after pip install PyInquirer' || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL quickstart import failed on $(python3 --version): $(tail -1 /tmp/imp.log)"
python3 --version
/tmp/v/bin/pip show prompt_toolkit | grep -i version
echo 'from_dict.py line 9:'; sed -n 9p /tmp/v/lib/python3.11/site-packages/prompt_toolkit/styles/from_dict.py

/tmp/v/bin/python -c 'import prompt_toolkit.styles.from_dict; from PyInquirer import prompt, print_json; print("import ok")' > /tmp/imp.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -4 /tmp/imp.log; echo "import exit: $rc"; test $rc -eq 0 && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS prompt_toolkit==1.0.14 makes PyInquirer importable' || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL prescribed prompt_toolkit==1.0.14 still fails on $(python3 --version): $(tail -1 /tmp/imp.log)"

setup: printf '%s\n' 'from __future__ import print_function, unicode_literals' 'from PyInquirer import prompt, print_json' 'questions = [{"type": "input", "name": "first_name", "message": "What is your first name"}]' 'answers = prompt(questions)' 'print_json(answers)' > /tmp/q.py

printf '%s\n' 'import os, pty, sys, time, select' 'pid, fd = pty.fork()' 'if pid == 0:' '    os.execv("/tmp/v/bin/python", ["/tmp/v/bin/python", "/tmp/q.py"])' 'out = b""' 'def rd(t):' '    global out' '    end = time.time() + t' '    while time.time() < end:' '        r, _, _ = select.select([fd], [], [], 0.2)' '        if r:' '            try:' '                d = os.read(fd, 4096)' '            except OSError:' '                return' '            if not d:' '                return' '            out += d' 'rd(4)' 'try:' '    os.write(fd, b"Bob\r")' 'except OSError:' '    pass' 'rd(6)' 'try:' '    os.kill(pid, 9)' 'except OSError:' '    pass' 'os.waitpid(pid, 0)' 's = out.decode(errors="replace")' 'print("--- child output ---")' 'print(s)' 'print("--- end ---")' 'ok = "first_name" in s and "Bob" in s' 'print("observed first_name and Bob in print_json output:", ok)' 'sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' > /tmp/d.py
commands: python3 --version
/tmp/v/bin/python -c 'from PyInquirer import prompt, print_json; print("premise: import ok")' || echo 'premise: PyInquirer not importable on this interpreter'

timeout 60 python3 /tmp/d.py && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS quickstart prompt() returned dict keyed first_name and print_json printed it (Python 3.9, pty-driven)' || echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL quickstart did not print JSON with first_name/Bob (see child output above)'
ls /tmp/pyinq/examples

cd /tmp/pyinq && python3 -c 'import os; want=["editor.py","expand.py","list.py","password.py","when.py","checkbox.py","confirm.py","hierarchical.py","pizza.py","input.py","rawlist.py"]; missing=[f for f in want if not os.path.isfile("examples/"+f)]; print("missing examples:", missing); assert not missing' && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS all 11 listed example scripts exist under ./examples at the pinned commit' || echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL some listed example scripts are missing from ./examples (see missing list)'

cd /tmp/pyinq && .v/bin/pip install -e . > /tmp/pip.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -5 /tmp/pip.log; echo "pip install -e . exit: $rc"; test $rc -eq 0 || { echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL pip install -e . failed'; exit 1; }
cd /tmp/pyinq && .v/bin/pip show prompt_toolkit | grep -i version; echo '--- PyInquirer/__init__.py ---'; cat PyInquirer/__init__.py

cd /tmp && /tmp/pyinq/.v/bin/python -c 'from PyInquirer import prompt, print_json; print("import ok:", prompt, print_json)' > /tmp/imp.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -4 /tmp/imp.log; echo "import exit: $rc"; test $rc -eq 0 && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS pip install -e . yields importable prompt and print_json from repository code' || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL from-source install: quickstart import fails: $(tail -1 /tmp/imp.log)"

setup: printf '%s\n' 'import os, importlib, sys' 'types = ["input","confirm","list","rawlist","expand","checkbox","password","editor"]' 'present = [t for t in types if os.path.isfile("PyInquirer/prompts/%s.py" % t)]' 'print("prompt modules present:", present, "(%d/8)" % len(present))' 'res = {}' 'for t in types:' '    try:' '        importlib.import_module("PyInquirer.prompts." + t); res[t] = "import ok"' '    except Exception as e:' '        res[t] = "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)' 'for t in types:' '    print("  ", t, "->", res[t])' 'ok = len(present) == 8 and all(v == "import ok" for v in res.values())' 'print("all 8 types present and importable:", ok)' 'sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' > /tmp/types.py
commands: ls /tmp/pyinq/PyInquirer/prompts
cd /tmp/pyinq && .v/bin/pip show prompt_toolkit | grep -i version

cd /tmp/pyinq && .v/bin/python /tmp/types.py && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS one prompt module per documented type exists and imports with the repo-declared prompt_toolkit' || echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL not every documented question type has a present+importable prompt module (see per-type results)'

setup: printf '%s\n' 'import urllib.request, urllib.error, sys' 'u = "https://travis-ci.org/expobrain/PyInquirer.svg?branch=master"' 'try:' '    r = urllib.request.urlopen(u, timeout=30)' '    code, final, body = r.status, r.geturl(), r.read().decode(errors="replace")' 'except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:' '    code, final, body = e.code, e.geturl(), e.read().decode(errors="replace")' 'except Exception as e:' '    code, final, body = "ERR", str(e), ""' 'print("badge status:", code, "| final_url:", final)' 'print("body_head:", body[:300].replace("\n", " "))' 'ok = code == 200 and "passing" in body' 'print("live passing badge:", ok)' 'sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' > /tmp/badge.py
commands: echo 'note: badge owner is expobrain, repo owner is CITGuru'

python3 /tmp/badge.py && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS travis-ci.org badge returns 200 with a passing build' || echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL travis-ci.org badge is not a live passing build (see status/final_url/body_head)'

cd /tmp/pyinq && venv/bin/pip install -r requirements_dev.txt > /tmp/reqdev.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -3 /tmp/reqdev.log; echo "pip install -r requirements_dev.txt exit: $rc"; test $rc -eq 0 || { echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL pip install -r requirements_dev.txt failed'; exit 1; }

cd /tmp/pyinq && ls tests/ && timeout 90 venv/bin/pytest -sv tests/ > /tmp/pytest.log 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -30 /tmp/pytest.log; echo "pytest exit: $rc"; test $rc -eq 0 && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS documented contributor flow installs and pytest -sv tests/ passes' || echo "VERDICT_LINE: FAIL pytest -sv tests/ exited $rc: $(grep -E 'passed|failed|error' /tmp/pytest.log | tail -1)"

setup: printf '%s\n' 'import urllib.request, urllib.error, json, sys' 'h = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": "repo-probe"}' 'try:' '    d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/repos/CITGuru/PyInquirer/issues/159", headers=h), timeout=30))' 'except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:' '    print("issue #159 fetch failed: HTTP", e.code); sys.exit(1)' 'repo = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/repos/CITGuru/PyInquirer", headers=h), timeout=30))' 'print("issue #159 title:", d["title"], "| state:", d["state"], "| created:", d["created_at"], "| comments:", d["comments"])' 'print("repo pushed_at:", repo["pushed_at"], "| archived:", repo["archived"])' 'sys.exit(0 if d["state"] == "open" else 1)' > /tmp/issue.py
commands: python3 /tmp/issue.py && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS issue #159 exists and is still open (see title above)' || echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL issue #159 missing or not open'

setup: printf '%s\n' 'import urllib.request, urllib.error, json, sys' 'h = {"Accept": "application/vnd.github+json", "User-Agent": "repo-probe"}' 'try:' '    rel = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("https://api.github.com/repos/CITGuru/PyInquirer/releases/tags/1.0.3", headers=h), timeout=30)); rel_ok = True; rel_info = rel.get("published_at")' 'except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:' '    rel_ok = False; rel_info = "HTTP %s" % e.code' 'p = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/PyInquirer/json", timeout=30))' 'v = p["info"]["version"]' 'print("github release tag 1.0.3 exists:", rel_ok, "published_at:", rel_info)' 'print("pypi latest version:", v, "uploaded:", p["releases"][v][0]["upload_time"], "| requires_dist:", p["info"]["requires_dist"])' 'ok = rel_ok and v == "1.0.3"' 'print("release exists and matches pypi latest:", ok)' 'sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)' > /tmp/rel.py
commands: python3 /tmp/rel.py && echo 'VERDICT_LINE: PASS GitHub release 1.0.3 exists and PyPI latest is 1.0.3' || echo 'VERDICT_LINE: FAIL release 1.0.3 missing on GitHub or PyPI latest differs (see values above)'
